div.head: Leis Wl 17a
div.ab: [Le seignur pur un den. que il dourad si erunt quites ses bordiers e ses boverz e ses serjanz.
[By the payment of one penny on the part of a lord his labourers, herdsmen and servants shall be exempt.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 260–261 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; 17a and 17b are from I (not in Hk) (Robertson).
